_about: William Butler Yeats. Bloom's Western Canon (1994) lists: A Vision; Collected Plays; Mythologies; The Collected Poems. Bloom addition 2026-11-03 under Adam's Bloom-only ruling; each row is US public domain (title page, Gutenberg header or IA metadata read, recorded in _bloom).

yeats-poems.evidence: PG text read: Yeats's own collected early poems (Crossways, The Rose, Wanderings of Oisin, plus Countess Cathleen and Land of Heart's Desire).
yeats-poems.case: Bloom lists The Collected Poems (1933). Its contents up to The Tower (1928) are US-PD; these three volumes cover all of it except The Winding Stair (1933).
yeats-poems.note: The Winding Stair and later poems are NOT PD, so the full 1933 Collected Poems cannot be added. We already hold no Yeats poetry, only the yeats-folk prose shelf.

yeats-later-poems.year: 1926 printing (title page: Macmillan, London 1926; 'First Edition November 1922, reprinted ... March 1926')
yeats-later-poems.evidence: Read title page and preface: 'all poetry not in dramatic form that I have written between my seven-and-twentieth year and the year 1921'; Cornell copy, no known US copyright restrictions.

yeats-plays-prose-verse.year: 1922 (title page: Macmillan, London 1922; 'First Edition November 1922, Reprinted December 1922')
yeats-plays-prose-verse.evidence: Read title page and preface: all Yeats's Abbey plays except Land of Heart's Desire and Countess Cathleen; University of Toronto copy.
yeats-plays-prose-verse.case: Bloom lists the Collected Plays (1934/1952). These two Macmillan volumes are Yeats's own pre-1931 collected plays; together with Poems (PG 38877, which holds Countess Cathleen and Land of Heart's Desire) they cover every play through the dance plays.
yeats-plays-prose-verse.note: Plays after 1924 (The Words upon the Window-pane, Purgatory, etc.) are not PD. PG also has several plays singly (Countess Cathleen 5167, Land of Heart's Desire 5168, Hour Glass 7448, King's Threshold 41102, Two Plays for Dancers 33321).

yeats-plays-controversies.year: 1924 (title page: New York, Macmillan 1924; 'New and Revised Edition. Published August, 1924')
yeats-plays-controversies.evidence: Read title page and preface: two early plays, Four Plays for Dancers, and the Samhain dramatic notes; Wellesley College copy, collection internetarchivebooks (not lending).
yeats-plays-controversies.case: Bloom lists the Collected Plays (1934/1952). These two Macmillan volumes are Yeats's own pre-1931 collected plays; together with Poems (PG 38877, which holds Countess Cathleen and Land of Heart's Desire) they cover every play through the dance plays.
yeats-plays-controversies.note: Plays after 1924 (The Words upon the Window-pane, Purgatory, etc.) are not PD. PG also has several plays singly (Countess Cathleen 5167, Land of Heart's Desire 5168, Hour Glass 7448, King's Threshold 41102, Two Plays for Dancers 33321).

yeats-vision.year: 1925 (title page: London, privately printed for subscribers only by T. Werner Laurie, 1925)
yeats-vision.evidence: Read title page, limitation notice (600 numbered signed copies) and contents (Books I-IV); collection opensource.
yeats-vision.case: Bloom lists A Vision. The first version (1925) is US-PD; this scan is that private Werner Laurie edition.
yeats-vision.note: The 1937 rewritten A Vision is a substantially different text and is NOT PD. Shelve this clearly as the 1925 version.

yeats-rosa-alchemica.evidence: PG title/author checked in catalogue and header.
yeats-rosa-alchemica.case: Bloom lists Mythologies (a 1959 gathering). All its contents are pre-1931 and PD; we already hold The Celtic Twilight, The Secret Rose and Stories of Red Hanrahan, so these three complete it.
yeats-rosa-alchemica.note: Held part: yeats-folk shelf (relay). The 1959 Mythologies volume itself is not needed.
